svg.title: DIA-008B · The long arm, unattended
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a lever. A boulder labelled the system sits on the short end. The long arm carries twelve numbered notches, twelve nearest the fulcrum and one at the far tip, for Meadows' twelve leverage points. Small weights stand for governance instruments. Most hang at notches twelve to ten beside the fulcrum. The far end, notches two and one, carries only dashed outlines.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 8 · WHERE YOU HAVE LEVERAGE
“Give me a place to stand, and I shall move the earth.”
Most of the weight hangs here,
a hand's breadth from the fulcrum.
Here a hand would move it.
DIA-008B · Meadows' twelve places to intervene, drawn as the lever they describe. Each weight is one governance instrument.
